title: Development of an Electromechanical Handbike Prototype Attachable to Conventional Wheelchairs
content: This article presents the development of a prototype of an electromechanical Handbike that can be attached to conventional wheelchairs. A mechatronic design methodology is presented to subsequently design the device, considering the dimensions of a conventional wheelchair. Subsequently, simulations by the finite element method (FEM) are developed to study the structural behavior of the designed device coupled to a wheelchair. Likewise, the construction and assembly of the prototype is carried out by selecting each of the necessary elements. Finally, the validation tests corresponding to speed, reproducibility and autonomy of the device were carried out, obtaining speeds of 13 km/h for a set of three users of different weights and heights, and an autonomy of 2 hours maximum.
